failureMessage: this checkout's local main can sit pinned at the repo's very first commit, so branching from it silently starts from frozen history

guardToolCalls.what: a git branch created from bare "main" ("{match}")
guardToolCalls.fix: git fetch origin main, then branch from origin/main explicitly

failureMessage: pulling another ref's whole tree onto the branch in flight overwrites uncommitted delivery work with that ref's files instead of leaving it to compare from

guardToolCalls.what: a git checkout of another ref's whole tree onto the current branch ("{match}")
guardToolCalls.fix: git worktree add /tmp/<name> <ref>, compare or read from there, then git worktree remove it — never git checkout <ref> -- . on the branch you're about to push
